Interface Updatable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Bible, Blue, Cleave, Dismantle, Harvest, Infinity, Lazer, MalevolentKitchen, MaximumBlue, MaximumCleave, MaximumDismantle, MaximumOutputInfinity, MaximumRed, Red, Soda, Standard, UnlimitedHollowPurple, Weapon
public interface Updatable
Implemented by active game objects that need per-frame logic updates.

The game loop in GameManager.update(double) iterates over the usingWeaponList and usingItemList collections and calls update(double) on each element. Once isExpired() returns true, the element is removed from the collection.

Note: Weapon also has a separate use(double) method (called on the equipped weapon every frame); update() is called on a spawned projectile instance that was added to usingWeaponList.

    • isExpired

      boolean isExpired()
      Returns true when this object has finished its job and should be removed from the active list.

      A weapon projectile returns true after it has travelled its maximum range or lifetime; a consumable item returns true after its effect has worn off.

      Returns:
      true if this object should be discarded
